caveat: Amazon only exports units that MISSED, so the rule is learned from failures. It reproduces Amazon's published rate closely but is an approximation of a promise only Amazon sets. Re-calibrate whenever a fresh export and a fresh Seller Central percentage are to hand.
note: Days from OUR ship confirmation to Amazon's promised delivery date. Learned from Amazon's own Unit On-Time Delivery export, then calibrated against the rate Seller Central actually published for the same window: these values reproduce 82.2% where Amazon reported 81.2%.
